journey.name: AX-02 The row checkbox announces the same label whatever its state
journey.description:
KNOWN-DEFECT WATCHLIST. Expected to fail if the current behaviour is judged wrong; see qa/TEST-PLAN.md.
TaskRow sets a single static content description on the checkbox (TaskRow.kt:69, the string task_list_action_toggle = "Mark complete"). It does not flip to "Mark incomplete" when the task is already done, so TalkBack announces the wrong action on every completed row: a user is told they can mark complete something that already is.
The checked state itself is exposed correctly, so a screen reader is not left with nothing - but the label contradicts it. NFR-09 asks that icon-only controls carry descriptions; it is silent on whether they must stay accurate, which is what makes this a decision rather than an unambiguous bug.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Verify that the "Book dentist" row has a checked checkbox
